verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a documentation site generator, so it could plausibly expose an MCP server for agents to search a published site and read its pages; the axis applies. The evidence covers only static HTML builds, Algolia DocSearch for human-facing search, and a plugin architecture. Nothing shows an MCP server, first-party or plugin-based, and probes found no machine-readable surfaces such as llms.txt, markdown endpoints or OpenAPI.
